title_zh: 周深：以空灵高音走红的新生代歌手
title_en: Chinese Pop Songs (9/20): Zhou Shen, a New-Generation Star with an Ethereal High Voice
note_en: 一…就… links two actions so that the second follows the first immediately: 一开口唱歌，就让观众和评委感到惊讶 "the moment he opened his mouth to sing, he astonished the audience and the judges." English needs a conjunction like "as soon as" or "the moment," but Chinese simply puts 一 before the first verb and 就 before the second, with no subject repeated.
